arguments.summary: The pgbouncer service was in a degraded state with 1388 failed jobs in the backlog. There were 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table which blocked the retry queue. After deleting the malformed rows, the queue has been unblocked and the pgbouncer service has been restarted.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the pgbouncer service and the failed_jobs table to ensure the issue does not recur. If the issue persists, investigate the root cause of the malformed rows and implement a solution to prevent similar issues from arising in the future.
